evidence.observation: Smooth monotonic warm-up across all stages (reboiler 275→285 °C, top 37.5→40.3 °C), consistent gradient maintained
System pressure steady near 498-500 mbar with normal noise
Differential pressures stable ~0.7-0.9 and ~1.9-2.1 mbar, no flooding or blockage signature
Reflux ~0.4 L/h and distillate ~0.67 L/h steady; ratio noisy but stationary ~5.5

args.missing_evidence: A distillate/bottoms composition measurement (e.g., GC analysis) to judge whether the target separation is achieved; also steady-state top temperature plateau.
